subject: general
question: Town N is to the east of Town O. Town P is to the north of Town N. Town Q is to the south of Town P. Town R is to the west of Town Q. Town O is to the north-east of Town R. What is the position of Town N with respect to Town Q?
solution:
Given: 

Town N is to the east of Town O.

Town P is to the north of Town N.

Town Q is to the south of Town P.

Town R is to the west of Town Q.

Town O is to the north-east of Town R. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/003692ebee1a191bb1356bac7c7fc94c8d36383566c24126bc24055124d281ac.png] 

Thus, Town N is to the north of Town Q.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
